name: std::basic_string<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::front
intro: Returns reference to the first character in the string. The behavior is undefined if empty() is true.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reference to the first character, equivalent to operator[](0).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: In libstdc++, front() is not available in C++98 mode.
